pages.text: Four iron nuggets surround Luminous Slime. Four small crystal clusters in a 2×2 square make one large cluster.

The Slimic Decorations tab holds 31 props and plants. Wood-and-stick furniture uses distinct patterns; an Old Slime Banner also needs green wool. Recraft one Abandoned Crate into a Broken Crate. Most solid props face you, need a firm floor and can hold water. Their shapes match the visible parts.

Crates, urns, racks, benches, basins and broken workbenches are decorative. Use Slime Chests for cargo and crafting tables for recipes. Gel Lanterns, Ancient Braziers, crystals and Glowing Blooms give light; Dormant Beacons do not. Plant roots, tufts, caps and blooms on suitable damp soil.
